verdict.rationale: Stable documents AI features: AI document summaries of mail and an 'AI-powered inbox' that automatically sorts and routes mail. Neither is a built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to, such as a chat or agent interface that takes instructions and acts. These are adjacent automated features, not the story's capability, so no evidence shows the product delivers it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
